text:
You need someone to sell ads for your AI newsletter by doing cold emails, follow-ups, calls, and customer Q&A for big AI companies.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience building and working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. While my background is technical, I’ve built systems that required clear communication, precise follow-up, and reliable user support.

I built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page used; it reached 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and cut clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. I also built product recommendation carousels for Tidewater Outfitters trained on 1.2M interactions, which increased click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test.

I’d be glad to help with outreach, follow-up, and handling buyer questions.
